title: Strongly coupled quantum discrete Liouville theory I: algebraic approach and duality
abstract: The quantum discrete Liouville model in the strongly cou- pled regime, 1 < c < 25, is formulated as a well deﬁned quantum me- chanical problem with unitary evolution operator. The theory is self- dual: there are two exponential ﬁelds related by Hermitean conjugation, satisfying two discrete quantum Liouville equations, and living in mu- tually commuting subalgebras of the quantum algebra of observables.
